slides.title: Today's Blueprint
slides.content:
1. Analyze patterns in AI-generated, probability-driven responses.
  2. Explain how probability and statistics drive these responses.
  3. Refine outputs through strategic prompt iteration.

slides.title: Predictable, Not Smart
slides.content:
The Key on the Table Problem.

Contextual & Logical: A key on a table (human understanding of leaving a key by the door).

Literal & Fragmented: key on table (AI rendering a giant key taking up the whole table).

AI failed to consider the whole sentence logically and prioritized literal details.

slides.title: The Engineering Vocabulary
slides.content:
• Abstraction: Focusing on the important information and ignoring irrelevant details.
  • Prompt: A question, instruction, scenario, or statement provided by the user to guide the AI's response.

slides.title: The Prompting Loop
slides.content:
The 3X Loop:

  1. Input: Text + Multimodal (Images)
  2. Analyze: Review the probability-driven output.
  3. Refine: Adjust context and constraints.

The Golden Rule: Require at least three back-and-forth interactions for effective refinement.

slides.title: Rapid Roundtable
slides.content:
How can I use AI effectively?

  • Require at least 3 interactions.
  • Add multimodal images for better context.
  • Be highly specific.
  • Remember it's literal, not smart!

Discussion Prompts:

  • Which specific strategies yielded the best outputs?
  • How did adding multimodal inputs (images) change the abstraction?
  • How did your 3rd prompt differ from your 1st?

quiz.question: What does the 'Key on the Table' problem illustrate about AI?
options: AI perfectly understands logical human context.
AI fails to consider the whole sentence logically and prioritizes literal, fragmented details.
AI is unable to draw tables.
AI needs multimodal images to draw a key.

quiz.question: What is the definition of 'Abstraction' in the context of engineering vocabulary?
options: A question or instruction provided to guide the AI.
Focusing on the important information and ignoring irrelevant details.
Predicting what comes next using probability.

quiz.question: What is the 'Golden Rule' of the Prompting Loop?
options: Require at least three back-and-forth interactions for effective refinement.
Always start with 'Give me 3 gift ideas.'
Never use multimodal inputs like images.
